prose: AI researcher Mikita Balesni says on X that he believes OpenAI fired him, Tomek Korbak and Jasmine Wang for prioritizing safety over the company's near-term interests. He says two other safety researchers and he were fired last week. The statement accompanies the letter the three published.
This is the researchers' claim only; the excerpt has no OpenAI response.
highlights: Balesni says he and two colleagues were fired over safety priorities
Claim of the fired researchers, no OpenAI reply in the excerpt
Names Tomek Korbak and Jasmine Wang
